name: domain-property
description: Australian property data from Domain (domain.com.au): residential sale/rent listings, agencies, weekend auction results, suburb performance and demographics

connection.instructions:
Connect with a Domain developer API key — self-serve and free to create.

1. Sign up at **developer.domain.com.au**.
2. Create a **project** — the free *Agents & Listings* and *Properties & Locations* packages are attached automatically.
3. Open the project and copy its **API key**.

The free tier has a daily call quota suited to evaluation; upgrade the project's plan on the Domain portal for production volumes.
